components.name: Primary button
components.description: Compact primary action; extracted from the shared primary-button styling.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 33px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Bordered secondary action, with the existing surface-hover state.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 33px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--secondary); background: var(--surface); cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-hover); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45; }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Unfilled action used for editing, context preview, and other supporting commands.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-text-action:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .45; }

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Settings-form text field with visible label, placeholder, and supporting note.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { font-size: 11px; color: var(--secondary); font-weight: 500; } .ds-field > input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border-radius: 5px; padding: 9px 10px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field > input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-field > input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field > small { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Inspector tabs
components.description: Static specimen of the implemented tab strip; React owns selection and arrow-key behavior.
components.css: .ds-inspector-header { height: 48px; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); padding: 0 14px; gap: 6px; background: var(--panel); } .ds-inspector-tabs { display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-between; flex: 1; height: 100%; gap: 10px; } .ds-inspector-tabs button { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; position: relative; color: var(--muted); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-inspector-tabs button.ds-active, .ds-inspector-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-inspector-tabs button.ds-active::after { position: absolute; content: ""; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; } .ds-inspector-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: User message
components.description: Conversation prompt container; sample text is illustrative, not an executed request.
components.html:
You10:30

Continue the milestone with the current project constraints.
components.css: .ds-user-message { background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); border-radius: 9px; padding: 13px 17px; margin: 0 0 27px; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-message-overline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-message-overline time { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; } .ds-user-message p { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Request payload
components.description: Focusable, scrollable request-body surface with explicit synthetic sample provenance.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-request-payload { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--sidebar); color: var(--secondary); border-radius: 5px; padding: 11px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; overflow: auto; max-height: 460px; font-family: var(--code); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.75; margin: 0; } .ds-request-payload:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Nova Workbench extends a familiar Windows coding-workspace convention: compact project navigation, a readable conversation, a bottom-aligned composer, and an optional evidence inspector. Quiet charcoal and warm-light surfaces, system UI type, line icons, and restrained mint states provide Nova's identity without a competing brand treatment.
keyCharacteristics: Compact desktop controls and readable conversation text.
Tonal surfaces and quiet separators, with lift reserved for overlays.
Visible source context, run state, and check evidence.
Keyboard access and persistent, resizable workspace panes.
dos: Do extend the existing Windows-first sidebar/conversation/inspector convention.
Do use the semantic theme variables and the existing system-font stacks.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable labels, and access to truncated content.
Do show source freshness, check revision context, and uncertainty in words.
Do retain synthetic-data labels and provenance on screenshot test evidence.
donts: Don't add a competing brand, display-font identity, decorative gradients, or copied provider logos.
Don't add lift to ordinary content panels or turn status text into decorative chips.
Don't describe a finished agent turn, preview, or isolated passing check as a fully verified engineering result.
Don't treat this source extraction as completed rendered or native-platform QA.
